basic_info.description: Just two blocks from the vibrant Cortland shopping district, 379 Nevada Street is a beautifully updated mid-century home designed for both comfort and style. Sunlight floods the main level through oversized east-facing windows, where an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area connects seamlessly for everyday living and entertaining. Marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry and custom built-ins make the space both practical and beautifully appointed. Two bedrooms on this level share a bright, sunny, bathroom complete with decorative plaster walls and operable skylight. The lower level offers remarkable flexibility, featuring a third bedroom with a private en-suite bath, ideal for hosting guests or serving as a home office with a folding Murphy bed and built-in desk. Additional highlights include three storage closets, stacked laundry machines, and a spacious one-car garage with plenty of room for bikes or a workshop. Step outside to a lush private backyard with a sunlit deck, perfect for morning coffee or weekend gatherings. With easy access to both 101 and 280, this home balances commuter convenience with the walkability of one of Bernal Heights' most beloved neighborhoods.
